<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p>最近在网上看到一个问题：10亿QQ号如何去重？</p>
<p>我觉得挺有意思的。</p>
<p>今天这篇文章跟大家一起分享一下常见的解决方案，希望对你会有所帮助。</p>
<p>更多项目实战在我的技术网站：<a href="http://www.susan.net.cn/project" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://www.susan.net.cn/project</a></p>
<h2 id="一技术难点">一、技术难点</h2>
<h3 id="11-数据规模分析">1.1 数据规模分析</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>原始数据</strong>：10亿×8字节 = 8GB</li>
<li><strong>HashSet去重</strong>：至少16GB内存（Java对象开销）</li>
<li><strong>理想方案</strong>：&lt;1GB内存</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="12-核心挑战">1.2 核心挑战</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2238006/202512/2238006-20251215095607514-792805551.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="二单机解决方案位图法">二、单机解决方案：位图法</h2>
<h3 id="21-算法原理">2.1 算法原理</h3>
<p>利用位数组表示数字存在性：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class BitMap {  
    private final byte[] bits;  
    
    public BitMap(int maxNum) {  
        this.bits = new byte[(maxNum &gt;&gt; 3) + 1]; // 每byte存储8个数字  
    }  
    
    public void add(int num) {  
        int arrayIndex = num &gt;&gt; 3;  // num/8  
        int position = num &amp; 0x07;  // num%8  
        bits[arrayIndex] |= 1 &lt;&lt; position;  
    }  
    
    public boolean contains(int num) {  
        int arrayIndex = num &gt;&gt; 3;  
        int position = num &amp; 0x07;  
        return (bits[arrayIndex] &amp; (1 &lt;&lt; position)) != 0;  
    }  
}  
</code></pre>
<h3 id="22-qq号范围优化">2.2 QQ号范围优化</h3>
<p>QQ号范围：10000（5位） - 9999999999（10位）<br>
<strong>位图内存计算</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>(10^10 - 10^4) / 8 / 1024/1024 ≈ 1.16GB  
</code></pre>
<p><strong>优化方案</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 偏移量优化：存储(qq - 10000)  
public void add(long qq) {  
    long num = qq - 10000;  
    int arrayIndex = (int)(num &gt;&gt; 3);  
    int position = (int)(num &amp; 7);  
    bits[arrayIndex] |= 1 &lt;&lt; position;  
}  
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三进阶方案布隆过滤器">三、进阶方案：布隆过滤器</h2>
<h3 id="31-应对内存限制">3.1 应对内存限制</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2238006/202512/2238006-20251215095623412-1211769482.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="32-参数设计与实现">3.2 参数设计与实现</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class BloomFilter {  
    private final BitSet bitset;  
    private final int size;  
    private final int[] seeds;  
    
    public BloomFilter(int size, int hashCount) {  
        this.bitset = new BitSet(size);  
        this.size = size;  
        this.seeds = new int[hashCount];  
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; hashCount; i++) {  
            seeds[i] = i * 31;  
        }  
    }  
    
    public void add(String qq) {  
        for (int seed : seeds) {  
            int hash = hash(qq, seed);  
            bitset.set(Math.abs(hash % size), true);  
        }  
    }  
    
    public boolean contains(String qq) {  
        for (int seed : seeds) {  
            int hash = hash(qq, seed);  
            if (!bitset.get(Math.abs(hash % size))) {  
                return false;  
            }  
        }  
        return true;  
    }  
    
    private int hash(String value, int seed) {  
        // MurmurHash 实现  
        int result = 0;  
        for (char c : value.toCharArray()) {  
            result = seed * result + c;  
        }  
        return result;  
    }  
}  
</code></pre>

</tr>
</tbody>

<h2 id="四磁盘方案外部排序与多路归并">四、磁盘方案：外部排序与多路归并</h2>
<h3 id="41-处理流程">4.1 处理流程</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2238006/202512/2238006-20251215095638479-570266555.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="42-关键代码实现">4.2 关键代码实现</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 外部排序  
public void externalSort(String input, String output) throws IOException {  
    List&lt;File&gt; chunks = splitAndSort(input, 100_000_000); // 每个文件1千万  
    mergeFiles(chunks, output);  
}  

// 多路归并  
void mergeFiles(List&lt;File&gt; files, String output) {  
    PriorityQueue&lt;MergeEntry&gt; queue = new PriorityQueue&lt;&gt;();  
    List&lt;BufferedReader&gt; readers = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();  

    // 初始化堆  
    for (File file : files) {  
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(file));  
        readers.add(reader);  
        String line = reader.readLine();  
        if (line != null) {  
            queue.add(new MergeEntry(line, reader));  
        }  
    }  

    try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(output))) {  
        long last = -1;  
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {  
            MergeEntry entry = queue.poll();  
            long qq = Long.parseLong(entry.value);  

            // 去重：只写入不重复的QQ号  
            if (qq != last) {  
                writer.write(entry.value);  
                writer.newLine();  
                last = qq;  
            }  

            // 读取下一行  
            String next = entry.reader.readLine();  
            if (next != null) {  
                queue.add(new MergeEntry(next, entry.reader));  
            }  
        }  
    } finally {  
        readers.forEach(r -&gt; { try { r.close(); } catch (IOException e) {}});  
    }  
}  

class MergeEntry implements Comparable&lt;MergeEntry&gt; {  
    String value;  
    BufferedReader reader;  

    public MergeEntry(String value, BufferedReader reader) {  
        this.value = value;  
        this.reader = reader;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int compareTo(MergeEntry o) {  
        return this.value.compareTo(o.value);  
    }  
}  
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五分布式解决方案">五、分布式解决方案</h2>
<h3 id="51-分片策略设计">5.1 分片策略设计</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2238006/202512/2238006-20251215095650890-2023178236.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="52-spark实现方案">5.2 Spark实现方案</h3>
<pre><code class="language-scala">val qqRDD = spark.read.textFile("hdfs://qq_data/*.txt")  
  .map(_.toLong)  
  .repartition(1000)  // 分为1000个分区  

// 每个分区内部去重  
val distinctRDD = qqRDD.mapPartitions { iter =&gt;  
  val bitmap = new RoaringBitmap()  
  iter.foreach(qq =&gt; bitmap.add(qq.toInt))  
  bitmap.iterator.asScala.map(_.toLong)  
}  

// 全局去重（可选）  
val globalDistinct = distinctRDD.distinct()  

globalDistinct.saveAsTextFile("hdfs://result/")  
</code></pre>
<h3 id="53-内存优化roaringbitmap">5.3 内存优化：RoaringBitmap</h3>
<p><strong>存储优势对比</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>普通位图：10^10 / 8 / 1024/1024 ≈ 1.16 GB  
RoaringBitmap：稀疏数据下可压缩至100-300 MB  
</code></pre>

<h3 id="63-实时去重实现">6.3 实时去重实现</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class QQDeduplication {  
    private static final String REDIS_KEY = "qq_set";  

    public boolean isDuplicate(String qq) {  
        try (Jedis jedis = jedisPool.getResource()) {  
            // 使用HyperLogLog进行基数估计  
            if (jedis.pfcount(REDIS_KEY) &gt; 1_000_000_000L) {  
                return true; // 已超过10亿，直接返回重复  
            }  
            return jedis.sadd(REDIS_KEY, qq) == 0;  
        }  
    }  
}  
</code></pre>
<h2 id="七终极方案分层位图索引">七、终极方案：分层位图索引</h2>
<h3 id="71-架构设计">7.1 架构设计</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2238006/202512/2238006-20251215095713819-668309848.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="72-存储计算">7.2 存储计算</h3>
<p><strong>QQ号范围</strong>：10000 - 9999999999（约100亿）<br>
<strong>分层设计</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>第一层分片：100个区间（每区间1亿）</li>
<li>第二层分片：100个子区间（每区间100万）</li>
<li>第三层存储：RoaringBitmap（每分区1.2MB）</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>总内存需求</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>100 × 100 × 1.2MB = 12GB（分布式存储可行）  
</code></pre>
<h3 id="73-java实现">7.3 Java实现</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class LayeredBitmap {  
    private final RoaringBitmap[][][] bitmaps;  
    private static final int L1 = 100; // 一级分片  
    private static final int L2 = 100; // 二级分片  

    public LayeredBitmap() {  
        bitmaps = new RoaringBitmap[L1][L2][];  
    }  

    public void add(long qq) {  
        int l1Index = (int)((qq - 10000) / 100_000_000);  
        long remainder = (qq - 10000) % 100_000_000;  
        int l2Index = (int)(remainder / 1_000_000);  
        int value = (int)(remainder % 1_000_000);  

        if (bitmaps[l1Index][l2Index] == null) {  
            bitmaps[l1Index][l2Index] = new RoaringBitmap();  
        }  
        bitmaps[l1Index][l2Index].add(value);  
    }  

    public boolean contains(long qq) {  
        // 类似add的分片计算  
        RoaringBitmap bitmap = bitmaps[l1Index][l2Index];  
        return bitmap != null &amp;&amp; bitmap.contains(value);  
    }  
}  
</code></pre>

<h2 id="九实战经验与避坑指南">九、实战经验与避坑指南</h2>
<h3 id="91-数据倾斜解决方案">9.1 数据倾斜解决方案</h3>
<p><strong>问题场景</strong>：部分QQ号段过于集中（如100000-199999）<br>
<strong>解决策略</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 动态分片函数  
int getShardId(long qq, int shardCount) {  
    String str = String.valueOf(qq);  
    // 取后6位作为分片依据  
    int suffix = Integer.parseInt(str.substring(Math.max(0, str.length() - 6)));  
    return suffix % shardCount;  
}  
</code></pre>
<h3 id="92-去重精度保障">9.2 去重精度保障</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2238006/202512/2238006-20251215095728820-479210304.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="93-成本优化建议">9.3 成本优化建议</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>冷热分离</strong>：热数据用内存位图，冷数据存磁盘</li>
<li><strong>压缩存储</strong>：使用RoaringBitmap替代普通位图</li>
<li><strong>分级存储</strong>：
<ul>
<li>最近3个月数据：内存存储</li>
<li>历史数据：HBase+压缩</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>分治思想</strong>：10亿问题拆解为1000个100万问题</li>
<li><strong>空间换时间</strong>：位图法用存储空间换取O(1)时间复杂度</li>
<li><strong>概率智慧</strong>：布隆过滤器用可控误差换取千倍空间压缩</li>
<li><strong>分层设计</strong>：亿级→百万级→万级分层处理</li>
<li><strong>动静分离</strong>：批处理处理历史数据，实时处理增量数据</li>
</ol>
<p>10亿QQ号去重的本质，是将问题拆解到每个计算单元都能高效处理的粒度。</p>
